SELECT
    (SELECT sql FROM main.sqlite_master WHERE type = 'view' AND name = 'sales_by_film_category') AS sales_view_definition,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.actor) AS actor_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.film_actor) AS cast_credit_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.payment WHERE rental_id IS NULL) AS payments_without_rental,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.payment WHERE typeof(amount) NOT IN ('integer', 'real')) AS non_numeric_payments,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM main.actor AS a
     WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM main.film_actor AS fa
            WHERE fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
              AND fa.film_id IN (
                  SELECT i.film_id
                  FROM main.inventory AS i
                  JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
                  JOIN main.payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
              )) < 3) AS actors_with_fewer_than_three_paid_films

SELECT
c.name AS category

FROM payment AS p

INNER JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
INNER JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
INNER JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id

arguments.sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM main.payment AS p
    JOIN main.rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    JOIN main.inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
cast_sizes AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count
    FROM main.film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        CAST(fr.total_revenue AS REAL) / cs.actor_count AS average_revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY fa.actor_id
            ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC, fa.film_id
        ) AS film_rank
    FROM main.film_actor AS fa
    JOIN film_revenue AS fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
    JOIN cast_sizes AS cs ON cs.film_id = fa.film_id
)
SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, f.title, rf.average_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films AS rf
JOIN main.actor AS a ON a.actor_id = rf.actor_id
JOIN main.film AS f ON f.film_id = rf.film_id
WHERE rf.film_rank <= 3
ORDER BY a.actor_id, rf.film_rank
LIMIT -1
